filters: actual Marketlens resolved_at <= cutoff when available
market-level duplicate removal by condition ID, then market ID
validation/test exclusions when original ZIP provided
sampling: Deterministic candidate hash by topic/year; target quotas; market structure/year diversity
training_priority: split training IDs favored when available
volume_provenance: Market-level USD lifetime volume in source snapshot, never predicted or summed across sources
as_of_limitation: Cannot reconstruct earlier volume-as-of-cutoff from later source snapshot; use contemporaneous snapshot for strict backtests
resolution_limitation: Primary end_date alone is scheduled end, not proof of settlement; Marketlens has observed resolution dates
